# REDFOXX

> REDFOXX is a Belgian sales service company for technical B2B companies. We run outbound sales (cold calling, email, LinkedIn) and inbound lead management (fast follow-up, qualification and demo booking) as an extension of your sales team.

## Services
- Outbound sales management: ICP research, list building, multichannel outreach and qualified meetings booked in your calendar.
- Inbound lead management: price requests, downloads, contact forms and questions followed up quickly, qualified, and demos booked in your calendar, working in your CRM where possible.

## Audience
Technical B2B companies (SaaS, IT, automation, machinery, intralogistics, engineering) in Belgium and the Benelux.

## Languages
Dutch (default), English, French.
